scientific_integrity.computational_validation: Exact-rational finite configurations corroborate, but do not prove, the universal formula.
scientific_integrity.established_result: Exact finite-depth signed real L-infinity Haar-unconditionality constant for every positive binary product probability, with a backward two-variable recursion, rare-path rigidity for strict biases, and homogeneous exact closed form.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Conditional expectation kernel rows, signed active-mass recursion, an affine Bellman envelope with explicit endpoint convex comparisons, and geometric-series algebra.
scientific_limitations: Requires product binary filtration with level-homogeneous conditional probabilities.
Does not address suppression-only transforms or finite L^p exponents.
The fair binary case is preexisting, not novel.
Bibliographic priority remains subject to older unindexed martingale-transform identities.

title: Sharp endpoint unconditionality on biased binary filtrations
